justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/BooleanMatcher.java, byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/ElementMatchers.java, and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/BooleanMatcherTest.java. BooleanMatcher is a small utility with one boolean field, one constructor, one factory, and no outbound dependencies beyond its superclass and annotations. Its incoming use is narrow: all production references are in ElementMatchers.java (six call sites in one utility class: any(), none(), canThrow(), declaresGenericException(), declaresException(), isChildOf()), plus its own test and one caching test. That is not the broad fan-in/fan-out pattern expected for hub-like modularization.
